Name: Brio of Life
Description: Brio had lived in this universe since it was young. Brio was given the responsibility of protecting the living universe and the welfare of all living beings. It is unknown whether or not she participated in the battle between Galactus and the other Proemial Gods. She is presumed dead but since there is no evidence that she has died it is unknown whether or not she is still alive. She is believed to be the first Celestial.
